construct: a CHILDLESS region whose only size facts are min-height / min-width
why: RC5. A childless slot hugs to 1px, so every slot-bearing component mints as a sliver or an empty box. The CSS-side precondition is that a region with NO children and no fixed size still reaches the contract carrying its minimum box. spec/channel-table.json classes min-height and min-width CARRIED (minHeight / minWidth).

canvas.note: minHeight on the childless region — the fact that stops an empty slot hugging to 1px
